The VELORA Process

A clearer route to the machine you want.

VELORA brings the dream, the numbers and the documentation into one customer journey. Every plan is subject to eligibility, executed agreements and applicable requirements.

01

Dream

Choose the car or bike you want and define the target purchase you are working toward.

02

Plan

Review the purchase price, down payment, finance amount and illustrative VELORA contribution.

03

Build

Complete eligibility checks and the required agreements and documentation before proceeding.

04

Own

Move ahead with the vehicle purchase and follow the agreed payment schedule through the plan term.

Trust & Transparency

Clear information. Written terms. No surprises.

VELORA is designed to make the ownership journey easier to understand. Before you commit to any arrangement, review the applicable terms, obligations, documents, payment schedule and responsibilities in writing.

01

Illustrative numbers

Figures shown in the plan builder are examples based on the information you enter. They are not a loan quote, approval, investment return or guaranteed saving.

02

Written terms first

Any final arrangement should be documented clearly, including amounts, dates, obligations, security arrangements, applicable charges and conditions before money changes hands.

03

Eligibility matters

Submitting an enquiry does not guarantee acceptance. Vehicle, lender, documentation, eligibility and other applicable conditions may affect the final structure.

04

Independent review

Customers should take appropriate legal, tax and financial advice where needed and independently verify the terms of any agreement before proceeding.

Privacy Notice

Last updated: 30 September 2026

VELORA uses information you submit through this website to respond to enquiries, understand your vehicle requirements, communicate about eligibility and documentation, and provide the services or discussions you request.

Information we may collect

  • Name, mobile number, city and occupation.
  • Vehicle preferences, approximate vehicle price, down payment, tenure and income information you choose to provide.
  • Messages and communications you send to VELORA.
  • Basic technical information required to operate and secure the website.

How information is used

Information is used for the specific purposes described when it is collected, including handling your enquiry and discussing applicable plans or documentation. We do not describe an enquiry as approval or a financial guarantee.

Sharing

Information may be shared with service providers or other parties where necessary to operate the requested service, complete an enquiry, comply with law, or protect rights and security. Any third-party processing should be governed by the applicable arrangement and law.

Your choices

You may contact VELORA at hellovelora09@gmail.com regarding questions about information you have submitted. Where applicable law gives you rights concerning your personal data, VELORA will handle requests according to that law.

This website is an informational and enquiry interface. The privacy wording should be reviewed and adapted by VELORA's legal adviser to its actual data flows, vendors, retention periods and regulatory obligations before launch.

Terms of Use

Last updated: 30 September 2026

By using this website, you acknowledge that its content is provided for general information and enquiry purposes. Vehicle listings, calculations, examples and descriptions may change and should be confirmed before any transaction.

Illustrative planning only

The calculator and examples are not loan offers, approvals, investment advice, promises of returns, or guarantees of eligibility. Actual terms depend on the relevant customer profile, lender or counterparty, documentation and executed agreements.

Vehicle information

Dream Garage entries are intended to help customers identify a target vehicle. Prices, availability, specifications and delivery conditions are not guaranteed by this website.

Third-party brands

Vehicle manufacturer names and marks belong to their respective owners. Unless expressly stated in a separate written agreement, VELORA does not represent that it is affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by those manufacturers.

Applications

Submitting an enquiry does not itself create a contract, loan, investment, agency relationship or entitlement to funding. Any binding relationship arises only under applicable written agreements.

Before accepting money, security instruments or commitments from customers, VELORA should have its final business structure and customer agreements reviewed by qualified Indian legal and regulatory advisers.

Important Disclaimer

Last updated: 30 September 2026

VELORA's website content is intended to help visitors explore dream vehicles and prepare an enquiry. Nothing on the site should be read as a promise that a customer will obtain financing, receive a particular return, save a specified amount, or complete a vehicle purchase within a specified period.

Any figures labelled illustrative, indicative or example are not final commercial terms. Customers should rely on signed agreements and verified information rather than website examples.

VELORA should not accept customer funds or issue security instruments through a process described on this website until the underlying business model, licensing or registration requirements, tax treatment, consumer disclosures and agreements have been reviewed for the applicable jurisdiction.

VELORA Records Admin

Manual browser-based record manager. Records are stored on this device only until you export them. For a real public website, exported records must be published into the site or connected to a secure database/CMS. Do not store bank account numbers, UTRs, cheque numbers, phone numbers or other sensitive personal data here.
Tip: Use customer IDs and display names. Add only records you are authorised to publish.
